narrative.overview: TaskFlow is a collaborative Kanban board built for small teams who need to organize work without drowning in features. The interface is a clean, flat canvas where board colors — not chrome — carry the personality. The system explicitly rejects the dense, dark-mode-heavy, enterprise-tool aesthetic of Jira and Linear. Instead it takes cues from Trello's simplicity: approachable, colorful, and unintimidating.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by default; surfaces are defined by subtle borders (gray-200), not shadows
Board colors are the primary source of visual personality — the UI chrome stays neutral
Lightweight interactions: inline edit, drag-and-drop, instant sync
Typography is single-family Inter at 14px body — no hero typography, no display flourishes
Motion is restrained: state transitions at 150–200ms, no choreographed entrances

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary Indigo covers ≤10% of any screen. Its restraint is the point — when the user sees Indigo, they know it means 'action.'

rules.name: The Board-Color-First Rule
rules.body: The UI chrome is always neutral (gray-50/gray-200/white). Color on the page comes from board swatches and priority badges, not from decorative UI accents.

rules.name: The No-Headline-As-Design Rule
rules.body: Headlines stay at 24px or below. There are no hero sections, no marketing typography. The app is a tool, not a landing page.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only in direct response to state (hover on actionable elements, open modals). No card ever has a resting shadow.

dos: Use the Indigo accent sparingly — one primary button, one link, one active tab per page.
Let board colors carry the visual personality. The chrome stays neutral.
Use borders, not shadows, to define containers at rest.
Prefer inline editing over modals for task properties (title, description, priority).
Keep motion to 150–200ms ease-out transitions (state changes only).
Show real-time status (Wifi icon) so the user knows sync is live.
Use the fade-in animation for entering modals and new content.
donts: Don't create a Jira/Linear/Notion clone — no dark mode by default, no dense sidebars, no overflowing metastrip headers.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or decorative blurs anywhere.
Don't apply shadows to cards at rest. Shadows mean 'this is elevated right now.'
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't put tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows ('CREATE' 'MANAGE') above section headings.
Don't hide primary actions behind nested menus or kebab icons — inline or directly visible.
Don't use hero-metric layouts (big number, small label, gradient accent).
Don't gate content visibility on class-triggered transitions.
Don't disable reduced-motion support. All animations must have a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce path.
